# Mixed Markup Sample

A cafe in the old quarter serves na Cafe latte beside a narrow window. The owner, Mrs O'Neill, greets every guest by name.

Visit the [reading room](https://example.com/reading) before noon; it closes early on Sundays.

```
const greeting = 'cafe';
console.log(greeting);
```

| Word | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| naive | showing a lack of experience |
| cafe | a small coffee shop |

![A quiet corner](https://example.com/corner.png)

Some visitors prefer a naive question to a clever answer, and they write it down slowly.
